name: Bernauerhof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Bernauerhof, also known as Hotel Bernauer Hof, is a hotel in Auffach in the municipality of Wildschönau in the Kufstein district of Tyrol. Its address is Auffach 157, 6313 Wildschönau. Auffach is the fourth church village of the Wildschönau and lies at around 875 metres above sea level at the foot of the Schatzberg. From Auffach, the Schatzbergbahn cable car leads directly into the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski area; the valley station is only around 700 metres from the stated address. The Wildschönau is a high valley in the Kitzbühel Alps and consists of the four villages of Niederau, Oberau, Auffach and Thierbach. Auffach serves as a starting point for hikes and winter sports on the Schatzberg.

History/Background

Auffach was formerly the centre of timber rafting in the high valley, and the place name derives from 'catching wood' (Holz auffangen). Today the village is known as the Schatzberg village and forms the direct access to the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski area. The Wildschönau itself is a traditional Tyrolean high valley that was originally agricultural in character and today depends heavily on tourism. No reliable historical information has been handed down about the Bernauerhof itself; speculation about its founding or ownership history is therefore deliberately avoided.

Getting there

The Wildschönau is easily reached via Wörgl and is only around 30 minutes from Kufstein and Kitzbühel. From Wörgl the road leads into the high valley; within the Wildschönau you reach Auffach via the villages of Oberau and Mühltal. The Schatzbergbahn in Auffach serves as a good landmark for driving to the district. Hiking buses run in the region, connecting popular starting points and mountain railways in the summer season. For specific parking and arrival details of the property, it is advisable to clarify these directly before arrival.

Tips

The sights of Auffach include the 1st Tyrolean Wood Museum with around 3,000 exhibits, which offers insights into the history and use of wood. The Schatzbergbahn takes you up the mountain of the same name, from which numerous circular and high-altitude trails start. From the Schönangeralm at the end of the valley, tours lead to the Breitegg, the Sonnjoch or the Großer Beil, at 2,309 metres the highest peak of the Wildschönau; a show dairy invites you to stop for refreshments. In winter, Auffach is directly connected to the Ski Juwel ski area. The Wildschönau Card bundles services such as mountain railways and hiking buses.

Best time to travel

For hikers and mountaineers, the summer months are ideal, when the mountain railways and huts are open and the trails around Schönangeralm and Schatzberg are walkable. Winter sports enthusiasts find conditions in the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski area from December into spring.
